theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_limit_stationary
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → IsVarifoldTangent V x C → C.Stationary
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
